setup.title: Choose a passphrase
setup.introCreator: Flatpare encrypts your household's data in your browser. This passphrase protects your keys; Flatpare never sees it and cannot reset it for you. You will get a recovery kit on the next screen — keep it safe.
setup.introJoiner: Flatpare encrypts your household's data in your browser. This passphrase protects your keys; Flatpare never sees it and cannot reset it for you. Once your keys exist, someone in your household will let you in automatically the next time they open Flatpare.

unlock.title: Unlock Flatpare
unlock.intro: Enter your passphrase to decrypt your household's data on this device.
unlock.notPersistent: This browser can't remember your keys between visits (private browsing?), so you'll be asked for your passphrase each time.

pending.title: Almost there
pending.waiting: Waiting for someone in your household to open Flatpare. They don't need to do anything — it happens automatically.
pending.polling: {seconds, plural, one {This page checks again every second.} other {This page checks again every # seconds.}}

householdKey.title: A new household
householdKey.intro: This household has no encryption key yet. Creating one makes it yours: everything you add is encrypted under it, and you will get a new recovery code to keep.
householdKey.failed: Could not create the household key

recoveryKit.title: Your recovery kit
recoveryKit.intro: Write this code down or print it and keep it somewhere safe. It is the only way to get your household's data back if you forget your passphrase and nobody else in your household can let you in. It is shown once.
recoveryKit.acknowledge: I understand that if I lose both my passphrase and this recovery kit, my household's data cannot be recovered by anyone, including Flatpare.

forgot.startOver: Flatpare cannot reset your passphrase. You can start over with new keys and be let back in by someone in your household.
forgot.startOverOrKit: Flatpare cannot reset your passphrase. You can start over with new keys and be let back in by someone in your household, or use your recovery kit.
forgot.soleHolder: Nobody else in your household holds the key, so a reset could not be completed — use your recovery kit.

reset.title: Reset my keys
reset.intro: You will get new keys under a new passphrase and wait for someone in your household to open Flatpare. If you are the only member, use your recovery kit instead — a reset alone cannot bring the data back.

recover.title: Use my recovery kit
recover.done: Recovered. Your old recovery kit no longer works — here is the new one.

settings.title: Encryption
settings.off: Encryption: off — set by this deployment.
settings.explain: Locking clears the keys from this browser; you will need your passphrase next time. Regenerating the recovery kit replaces the old code — the old one stops working immediately.

provider.adoptFailed: The key we received could not be opened. Reset your keys so a member can send a new one, or use your recovery kit.

errors.badRecoveryCode: That recovery code is not valid
errors.ownerOnlyHouseholdKey: Only the owner can create the household key
errors.noHouseholdKey: You do not hold the household key
errors.noRecoveryKit: This household has no recovery kit
